## 2024-05-24 - Fix Reverse Tabnabbing in Markdown Generator
**Vulnerability:** External links generated by `pubsFromBib.py` used `target="_blank"` without `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
**Learning:** This exposes users to reverse tabnabbing attacks, where the newly opened tab can manipulate the `window.opener` object to redirect the original page to a malicious site.
**Prevention:** Always use `rel="noopener noreferrer"` when using `target="_blank"` on external links.
